name: changes-drill
description: A Changes pane that says which turn changed each file and who (Claude, a subagent, Claude's shell or you), against HEAD, the session's start, the last turn or the base branch; with a guard for sensitive or out-of-scope files, a hunk peek, and a History section of the branches (you against main, every branch as lanes or a subway map, what happened). Read-only: it changes nothing in the repository. No model calls, no tokens and no network: local git only, read while the pane is up. Opened by /changes-drill, or by $.changesDrill.open() from another mod (motta-statusline's files).

groupBy.title: Group by
groupBy.description: turn: by the turn that last changed each file, titled with its prompt. folder: by folder. author: Claude, subagents, Claude's shell, you. stage: staged, partly staged, unstaged, untracked. flat: one list.

baseline.title: Compare against
baseline.description: HEAD: the work tree against the last commit. session start: what changed since the session began (a snapshot taken then, without touching the stash list). last turn: since the latest turn began. base branch: everything on the branch since it left origin's default branch (local refs only, nothing is fetched).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Within each group: recent (last changed first), lines (most changed first), path, or status letter.

bars.title: Line bars
bars.description: A bar per file of its lines added (green) and deleted (red), scaled to the largest file: blocks (five squares), proportional (a ten-cell line), or off.

density.title: Density
density.description: compact: one line per file. comfortable: a blank line between files.

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: When the pane reads git again while it is up: each turn (at its end), each edit (shortly after each Edit or Write), or manual (only on open and Refresh; turn alerts are off too).

showAge.title: Show age
showAge.description: How long ago each file last changed (4m, 3h).

showAuthor.title: Show who
showAuthor.description: Who last changed each file: Claude, agent, shell (Claude's own shell command) or you (outside Claude).

churn.title: Churn flag
churn.description: Mark files Claude edited many times this session (×5), a sign of going around in circles.

churnEdits.title: Churn at
churnEdits.description: The number of edits in the session that marks a file as churning.

guard.title: Guard
guard.description: Mark sensitive-looking files (.env, keys, credentials) and, with a scope set, files outside it; a toast once when a sensitive file shows up untracked and not ignored.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: A folder from the repository's root (plugins/changes-drill/) the work should stay inside; files outside it are marked. Empty: the whole repository.

testHint.title: Source without a test
testHint.description: Mark a changed source file whose unit (plugins/<x>/, packages/<x>/, or top folder) has no changed test.

foldGenerated.title: Fold generated files
foldGenerated.description: Fold lockfiles, build output, minified files and snapshots into one line you can unfold.

turnToast.title: Turn summary toast
turnToast.description: At the end of a turn that changed files, a toast naming them.

peek.title: Hunk peek
peek.description: Pressing a file shows the first lines of its diff under it (one git call, on the press); pressing it again hides them.

peekLines.title: Peek lines
peekLines.description: How many lines of the diff a peek shows.

history.title: History
history.description: A History section under the list: Me (your branch against main, or where your work sits), All (every branch as lanes or a subway map) and Current (what happened, or the changed files as a tree), each with its own picker. Read from local git when the pane opens, at a turn's end when a branch moved, and on its Refresh; never with the pane closed.

historyDepth.title: History depth
historyDepth.description: How many commits the History section reads, newest first.
